title: multi fitness proves deduplication and structured coordination with scripted agents: research and coord cases under coord shared and isolated
goal: the scripted research agent of bench_replay.py takes the real coord path, KB_COORD_HOLDER, coord.py dedup with --topic, its claims, fact_added events and release, and the scripted agents of the coord scenario claim the shared item, ask through kbask.py ask and answer through kbask.py answer; multi fitness --case NAME runs only the named cases, and each case's line prints its measures as name=value; the case research-shared passes only when the run's dedup_hits are at least one and dup_facts is 0, and coord-shared only when its claim_refused and asks_answered are each at least one and dup_facts is 0; and research-isolated and coord-isolated pass only when dup_facts is at least one

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print('check failed:', e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import re, subprocess, sys
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "_tools/benchmarks.py", "multi", "fitness", "--case", "research-shared", "--case", "research-isolated"], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=3000)
assert r.returncode == 0, ("multi fitness research cases", r.returncode, (r.stdout + r.stderr)[-400:])
assert "research-concurrent" not in r.stdout, "--case ran other cases too"
def m(case):
    ln = [l for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if l.startswith("ok: " + case + ":")]
    assert ln, ("case did not run and pass", case, r.stdout[-400:])
    return {k: int(v) for k, v in re.findall(r"(\w+)=(\d+)", ln[0])}
s, i = m("research-shared"), m("research-isolated")
assert s.get("dedup_hits", 0) >= 1 and s.get("dup_facts") == 0, ("research-shared measures", s)
assert i.get("dup_facts", 0) >= 1, ("research-isolated measures", i)
